traceability.notes: docs/stories/007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING.story.md specifies cross-rule error reporting behavior: specific, actionable, consistent messages; inclusion of contextual data; appropriate severities; and integration with ESLint’s reporting and suggestion APIs. The implementation across the core rules (`require-story-annotation`, `require-req-annotation`, `require-branch-annotation`, `valid-annotation-format`, `valid-story-reference`, `valid-req-reference`) defines message templates in `meta.messages` that follow the documented patterns and use data placeholders for function names, missing annotation types, paths, and requirement IDs. Tests explicitly tied to this story verify messageIds, data payloads, suggestion wiring (for `require-story-annotation`), and fs/error edge-case handling. Plugin config tests confirm severity conventions (warnings for format issues, errors for missing annotations and invalid references). All these tests pass in the current Jest run. Together, this provides concrete evidence that all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for Story 007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING are fully implemented and verified.
